text: When the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - approached Al-Safa, he recited: Indeed, Al-Safa and Al-Marwah are among the symbols of God Al-Baqarah: 158

He began with what God had begun with, so he began with Safa, then he moved up it until he saw the House, so he faced the Qiblah, so he united and magnified God, and said: There is no god but God, alone with no partner, to Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things. There is no god but God alone. He fulfilled his promise, gave victory to his servant, and defeated the parties alone, then he prayed between that and said like this three times; Hadith, in which he did the same thing on Al-Marwah as he did on Al-Safa
